$schema_note: Deterministic structure of a NEW-SYSTEM (data-mx) Rewind. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — consumed by validate-chapter-plan.py (mx-special checks, WP-6) and scripts/stitch_specials.py. Chrome is stitcher-owned and writer-unrepresentable. Spec: design-system-unification SPEC Part 1 (Law 5: Memory Test columns reveal in sequence; Law 7: the year-band cover), Part 7 §2 (Rewind bounded to its period) + §3 (Rewind = The Memory Test, graded next period) + §4 (reader's own angle as a chapter-level element), WP-6.

law2.planned_density_note: Same reachability model as season-review.json: est_screens_390 = words/250 + 0.5 x total_planned_events (writer events + stitcher structural: plates = n_chapters, act openers = n_acts, transits = n_acts - 1); reject when total/est < law2.floor.

acts.note: Editorial-skin arc in scrapbook paper tints; a chronological act split (early period -> late period) is the natural shape. Palettes from a motif pack or per-act tokens.

timing.note: Part 7 §2 — a Rewind is BOUNDED to its period. issue_meta.period = {label, start_date, end_date}; start_date < end_date and end_date <= issue_meta.date (you cannot rewind a period that hasn't finished).

signature_moment.note: Law 5: Rewind's signature — the Memory Test columns reveal in sequence. Stamped on the memory-test chapter wrapper; mx-motion.js sequences .mx-cheat__col/.mx-col children under tier1.

cover.gesture: the year-band (Law 7): the period code as an oversized band/ghost across the cover

chrome.note: Stitcher-owned: one .mx-mast, cover, .mx-actopen per act, .mx-transit per seam, one .mx-plate per chapter, back pill, .mx-footer. Structural events at plan time: n_chapters + n_acts + (n_acts - 1).

slots.notes: The period at a glance: the shape of the months in numbers + a taped calendar tear-off.
Thematic narrative chapters (news, sport, screen, personal threads) built from scrapbook objects: taped memory cards, photo corners, calendar tear-offs, report cards, cassette labels.
Part 7 §4 — the reader's own angle as a chapter-level element, SECOND PERSON, from state (training blocks, trips, the weekly's own coverage). plan.personalisation.chapter_id must point here.

THE KILLER FEATURE (Part 7 §3): The Memory Test — question columns over the period, GRADED NEXT PERIOD. Plan field `grading_note` commits when/where the answers get graded (the next Rewind). Carries the cols-reveal signature.
Which of the period's threads are still running — hand-off into the weekly's The Threads.

killer_features.desc: The Memory Test renders as cheat-sheet column furniture (the cols-reveal signature target).
The Memory Test commits to being graded next period (Part 7 §3).
